imagery_layer: 2025 definitive high-resolution RGB orthophoto; no Actueel or quick-ortho aliases
coarse_transform: Area-average downsample Dutch RGB to nearest integer dimensions for 25cm spacing, then bilinear return to the unchanged native grid. Labels, geographic extent and LiDAR are unchanged. UK sources unchanged.
height_source: AHN4 0.5m terrain/surface, same generation/grid/vertical datum; no filled missing cells
evaluation: Both fits exclude all Toverland records. Score both sealed candidates once on source-only provisional Toverland labels. Existing Alton probes development only.
source_labels: Assistant source-assisted dense labels and visible canopy; unknown shadows/hidden ground excluded
source_scale_note: This is a fixed-extent RGB-detail comparison at 8cm grid spacing, not a survey-accuracy validation or a replacement for larger-context training.
